description: Set (or clear with rule: null) automatic email reminders for recipients who haven't completed the quiz. Stops on completion, opt-out, or max_reminders.

quiz_id.description: Quiz id (the `id` field returned by create_quiz/list_quizzes).

after_hours.description: Hours to wait before each reminder (default 48).

message.description: Optional note used in reminder emails.

name: set_follow_up
title: Set Follow Up
